description: Root pom.xml - Added spring-cloud-azure-dependencies BOM with version 5.22.0 in dependencyManagement. This is compatible with Spring Boot 3.2.1 (spring-boot:3.x requires version >= 5.22.0). The change is correct and follows the guidance for Spring Boot 3.x projects.
Added spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency without explicit version (inherits from parent BOM). This follows best practices for dependency management through BOM import.
Added spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql dependency without explicit version (inherits from parent BOM). This follows best practices for dependency management through BOM import.

Database configuration migrated from password-based (spring.datasource.password=postgres) to passwordless authentication using managed identity. Changes include: 1) Removed spring.datasource.password property; 2) Updated spring.datasource.url to use environment variables and Azure PostgreSQL host; 3) Updated spring.datasource.username to use ${MANAGED_IDENTITY_NAME}; 4) Added spring.datasource.azure.passwordless-enabled=true; 5) Added managed identity and credential properties; 6) Added comprehensive comments about authentication options and Azure sovereign clouds. All changes are consistent with the migration guidance.
